description: By default 3DEC checks the true distance between a subcontact vertex and its associated face on the first calculation step and, if the gap is not zero, corrects the calculated normal displacements to account for the mismatch. This is sometimes not desired if a model is created with imperfect joint planes, resulting in variable normal displacements across a 'planar' joint; suppress the correction by setting the boolean to false. (Official 9.7 page; engine expects a boolean - verified against live 3DEC 9.7.47.)
